description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git am' command options and behaviors, including setup, execution, and validation of various scenarios involving patch application, skips, directory changes, and rejection handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success. Executes the provided commands and reports failure if they do not succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the mock timestamp used in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.
